stops the booking.words: A carbon monoxide alarm going off, or a gas smell
stops the booking.says: Get everyone outside now, pets too, and leave the door open. Don't flip switches or use a phone inside. From outside, call 911 and the gas company.
stops the booking.booking: No booking. A new request must say the house was cleared.

stops the booking.words: Someone feels sick, dizzy, or too cold or hot; smoke or a burning smell from the equipment
stops the booking.booking: No booking until it's safe; the customer can come back.

safety steps, then the booking goes on,.words: No heat in freezing weather, with an older person, a baby or someone with a medical need at home
safety steps, then the booking goes on,.says: Keep everyone in one warm room, in layers. Never heat the home with the oven, a grill or a camp heater: they can make carbon monoxide. If anyone seems unwell or too cold, call 911.

safety steps, then the booking goes on,.words: No cooling in great heat, with someone at risk at home
safety steps, then the booking goes on,.says: Move to the coolest room, drink water, and use fans. If anyone feels faint or confused, call 911.

safety steps, then the booking goes on,.words: Water dripping from the furnace or the AC
safety steps, then the booking goes on,.says: Turn the system off at the thermostat, and keep the water away from outlets.

set answers to risky questions.asks: Can I heat the house with the oven?
set answers to risky questions.says: Please don't: an oven used for heat can give off carbon monoxide.

set answers to risky questions.asks: Can I use a space heater?
set answers to risky questions.says: A plug-in space heater stays 3 feet from anything that can burn, and is never left on while you sleep.

set answers to risky questions: Any other question goes to the tech.

pf.safety.general screen: Always on: danger to life, fire, gas, or a medical emergency gets 'call 911' first.
